messages.text: Hello Jess, i'm Pauline. With Antoine, my boyfriend, we are looking for a place to stay during our time in Brisbane (around 6 to 8 months). We would like to find a job and discover the city. Your place seems great and we would be thrilled to see it ! We're arriving in Brisbane the 12th of April. Do you think we can organized a visit ? Can you also give the price for each room as a couple. Thank you in advance! Pauline
